title: PropShort — Real Estate News, Filtered for You
idea: 30-second PropShort app promotion using three authentic news screens and branded motion graphics. Script refers to visible screenshots, not independent live verification.
hook: Real estate moves fast. Stay informed with PropShort.

scenes.motion_prompt: Brand introduction on solid black, strong PropShort typography with orange underline and phone screenshot slide-in.
scenes.narration: Real estate news changes every day.
scenes.subtitle: REAL ESTATE MOVES FAST.
scenes.image_prompt: Screenshot of actual PropShort news feed

scenes.motion_prompt: PropShort news card in phone frame, orange animated counter counts from zero to 66.
scenes.narration: Sixty-six luxury apartments in Sarojini Nagar are set for auction.
scenes.subtitle: 66 LUXURY APARTMENTS
scenes.image_prompt: Use uploaded actual Sarojini Nagar auction article screenshot

scenes.motion_prompt: PropShort app screenshot slides in from right, headline reveals in black and orange on white.
scenes.narration: One reported land sale case involved eighteen lakh rupees.
scenes.subtitle: ₹18 LAKH LAND CASE
scenes.image_prompt: Use uploaded PropShort report of alleged land sale fraud

graphic.headline: ₹18 LAKH LAND CASE
graphic.subheading: Know the risks behind the headlines

scenes.motion_prompt: Phone screenshot zooms gently out, crisp header on cream, orange underline.
scenes.narration: Commercial property ownership rules in Chandigarh could change.
scenes.subtitle: POLICY UPDATES MATTER
scenes.image_prompt: Use uploaded PropShort Chandigarh freehold policy news screenshot

scenes.motion_prompt: Three genuine uploaded PropShort screenshots animate as a sequence of swiping phone cards.
scenes.narration: Stay up to date on auctions, property risks, and important policy news.
scenes.subtitle: NEWS THAT MATTERS TO YOU
scenes.image_prompt: Screenshots of real PropShort app news feed

scenes.motion_prompt: Orange brand background, white kinetic type, phone screen and clear website call-to-action.
scenes.narration: Discover PropShort. Real estate, filtered for you.
scenes.subtitle: DISCOVER PROPSHORT
scenes.image_prompt: Real PropShort UI and authentic branded logo if supplied
